decisions.reason: As a multi-model desk system tightly aligned with the firm's office expertise and the market shift toward flexible workplaces, it is likely to meet aspiration levels and the firm's slack supports retention.
The chair family is close to the core range and complements established interiors, so absent clear signs of underperformance management would more likely continue it than redeploy resources.

Floor cushions made from carpets look more peripheral to the firm's premium furniture core, so if results lag the aspirations set by stronger core lines this is a plausible candidate for problemistic search and withdrawal.

The upholstered sofa fits the firm's design-led living offer and received dedicated presentation after launch, suggesting acceptable performance relative to aspirations and no strong pressure to exit.
A high standing table matches the firm's workplace and lounge positioning and current demand for adaptable interiors, making continued offering more likely than discontinuation.

Although the rug collection is more distant from the established offer and therefore riskier, its role as a flagship direction and the firm's available organisational slack make continued support somewhat more likely than dropping it.
